data.heading: Frequently asked questions
data.subheading: Quick answers to the questions we hear most.

items.question: Is there a free trial?
items.answer: Yes — every plan comes with a 14-day free trial. No credit card required.

items.question: Can I cancel anytime?
items.answer: Absolutely. Cancel or change your plan at any time from your account settings.

items.question: Do you offer support?
items.answer: Our team is available around the clock by chat and email, and we reply within an hour.

items.question: Can I use my own domain?
items.answer: Yes. Connect any domain you own in a couple of clicks; SSL is included.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, backed up daily and hosted in the EU.
